title: Host transcriptomic responses to cancer in paired whole blood and saliva
description: Paired whole-blood and saliva bulk RNA-seq from 36 donors (27 cancer across six tumor types; 9 healthy controls; 72 libraries) to characterize complementary, non-redundant host transcriptomic responses across two biofluids.
